prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent illustration atlas for a Chinese talking-head explainer. Create FOUR original graphite pencil object studies, clean strict 2x2 arrangement: top-left a three-quarter view everyday tote shopping bag with handles and seams; top-right two plain unmarked metal coin discs slightly overlapping; bottom-left a simple shield with a clearly hand-drawn check mark; bottom-right a squat iron calibration weight with a loop handle. Each object entirely in its quadrant with at least 70px clear transparent separation, square image. Authentic observed graphite drawing: construction ellipses and faint perspective guides near each object, repeated searching contours, clearly varied pressure, fine HB hatching turning with volume, some dark 4B accents and lifted paper-white highlights. Restrained black and silvery gray only; high enough contrast to read at 300px object size. Real hand-drawn volumetric objects, NOT generic flat icons, no vector-perfect outlines. Transparent background with genuinely empty alpha outside the drawing; no paper rectangles, page, frame, art tools, labels, letters, currency signs, digits, logos or people. No museum work imitation. All four are explanatory concept illustrations rather than factual evidence.
